subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should OpenClaw extend `session_status.details` with structured `usage.session`, `usage.lastTurn`, cost, and budget/window metadata, or create a separate agent-facing usage tool that reuses the existing gateway usage pipeline?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix chooses a public agent tool contract, privacy/visibility boundaries, provider cost and quota semantics, and compatibility with existing rendered status output.

options.title: Extend session_status details
options.body: Add an optional structured `details.usage` payload while keeping the existing rendered text/status card behavior for current callers.

options.title: Add a separate usage tool
options.body: Create a dedicated read-only agent usage tool and leave `session_status` focused on the `/status`-style card and route/model state.

options.title: Keep usage gateway-only
options.body: Treat programmatic usage as an operator/gateway API surface and do not expose raw totals or costs directly to agents for now.

recommendation.title: Extend session_status details
recommendation.body: Add an optional structured `details.usage` payload while keeping the existing rendered text/status card behavior for current callers.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest prior review context and recent history around the `session_status`, status rendering, and usage surfaces involved in the product/API choice.
